sample.description: Daily closing prices for BTC,ETH,SOL,ADA,AVAX,LINK from Yahoo Finance (BTC-USD etc) Jan2023-Mar2026; controls VIX (^VIX), SP500 (^GSPC), DXY (DX-Y.NYB); 5-day forward realized volatility sqrt252*sd(r_{t+1:t+5}); filtered to trading days intersection for regressions. Kalshi macro contracts (10 series KXFED,KXCPI,KXCPICORE,KXGDP,KXU3,KXPCECORE,KXRECSSNBER,KXACPI,KXRATECUT,KXUSNFP) probed via public Kalshi API https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2

not_rebuilt.kalshi_KXFED_N: Public Kalshi API only returns markets created from 2025-08 onward (verified 22 settled KXFED), not Jan2023-Mar2026. Historical candlesticks for 2023 require start_ts/end_ts but API returns empty or not_found for pre-2025 tickers. No archive of daily volume-weighted probability changes Delta_vw Eq1 is publicly restorable.
not_rebuilt.kalshi_KXCPI_N: Same as above; settled KXCPI from 2026-02 only (29 markets). Cannot rebuild 384 usable days.
not_rebuilt.kalshi_KXRECSSNBER_N: 0 settled markets returned for KXRECSSNBER vs paper 569; series appears delisted or renamed in current API.
not_rebuilt.kalshi_KXACPI_N: 0 settled vs paper 283; series not found in current API.
not_rebuilt.kalshi_KXRATECUT_N: 28 vs 0 settled; series exists but no historical data beyond 2025.
not_rebuilt.kalshi_KXUSNFP_N: 0 as paper, but cannot confirm because API returns 0 for never-active vs retention limit.
not_rebuilt.kalshi_KXFED_median_volume: Requires daily dollar volume V_j,t per contract from Kalshi API; not available historically.
not_rebuilt.kalshi_KXFED_median_OI: Open interest time series not in public API beyond current snapshot.
not_rebuilt.btc_total_signals_tested: Requires all 10 Kalshi signals to test per BTC; without usable obs cannot enumerate.
not_rebuilt.btc_insample_N: Effective estimation N=318 after lagging and matching BTC returns with KXFED signal; cannot determine without KXFED daily Delta_vw series.
not_rebuilt.insample_cpi_N: N=264 for CPI signal; same issue.
not_rebuilt.btc_fed_dovish_coef: In-sample M3 coefficient requires Fed-dovish signal -Delta_vw_KXFED,t-1; signal unavailable historically.
not_rebuilt.btc_fed_dovish_t: Headline t=3.63 requires same signal and HAC SE; cannot compute without Kalshi.
not_rebuilt.cpi_ETH_coef: Requires KXCPI absolute probability change; not retrievable.
not_rebuilt.oos_BTC_rec_MSFE: Out-of-sample expanding window MSFE ratio requires forecasts from M3 vs M2 with Kalshi signal; not computable.
not_rebuilt.BH_BTC_fed_adj_p: Benjamini-Hochberg across 60 specs requires all t-stats, which require Kalshi signals.
not_rebuilt.ortho_fed_R2: Orthogonalization R2 of Kalshi on Fed Funds futures etc. requires Kalshi signal.
not_rebuilt.bootstrap_p: Moving-block bootstrap of BTC Fed-dovish spec requires signal.
not_rebuilt.baseline_FF_t: Baseline comparison vs Fed Funds futures requires Kalshi signal to estimate joint model.

sample.substitutions: Crypto prices: CoinGecko midnight-UTC in paper, substituted Yahoo Finance BTC-USD etc daily bars (verified same calendar coverage 2023-01-01 to 2026-03-31, closes should be highly correlated; paper uses log returns, source difference is caveat). Controls: VIX (^VIX), SP500 (^GSPC), DXY (DX-Y.NYB) via Yahoo Finance as proxies for CBOE VIX, S&P500, DXY index; Fed Funds futures and 10Y Treasury return and Deribit DVOL not fetched (require separate feeds). Kalshi: attempted public API https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2/markets and /markets/candlesticks (period_interval 1440, start_ts/end_ts seconds) verified live; historical retention only ~2025 onward, so volume-weighted Delta_vw Eq1 and absolute signals cannot be rebuilt. HAR controls and Newey-West HAC 5 lags would follow paper exactly if signal were available.

notes:
Choices paper leaves open, and deviations:
1. Kalshi signal construction Eq1: volume-weighted probability change Delta_vw_s,t = sum_j V_j,t*Delta_p_j,t / sum_j V_j,t. Public API provides daily candlesticks (yes_bid/ask, volume_fp, open_interest) but not historical daily volume-weighted probability change for Jan2023-Mar2026; current API retention only from ~2025-08 (verified: earliest KXFED settled created 2025-08-06, KXCPI 2026-02-19, KXRECSSNBER 0). Attempted fetching via /markets?series_ticker=KXFED&status=settled and /markets/candlesticks?period_interval=1440&start_ts&end_ts - returns 200 for recent but 404/empty for 2023 period. Therefore none of the 8 series' usable obs counts (469,384,331,424,389,294,569,283) could be rebuilt; reported as not_rebuilt.
2. Crypto vendor: paper says CoinGecko midnight-UTC close; we use Yahoo Finance BTC-USD etc via market_data.get_prices (cache first, yfinance live). Sample coverage verified 2023-01-01 to 2026-03-31 inclusive 1,186 calendar days vs paper 1,183 (difference 3 days, likely inclusive counting or missing data at boundaries). After excluding weekends/US holidays ~30% dropped, trading days intersection VIX/SP500/DXY =813 (paper reports merged N=1,183 calendar days but says weekends excluded; we interpret merged trading N=813 as effective). Descriptive N per crypto paper 1,178 vs our 1,181 RVol obs (RVol_{t}^{h=5}=sqrt252*sd(r_{t+1:t+5})) - difference 3 due to lag/window definition; we follow Eq2 exactly with ddof=1 sample sd.
3. RVol scaling: paper uses sqrt252 for comparability with equities; we use same. Calendar rescaling to sqrt365 would multiply by 1.20 but we keep 252 as footnote states. Our mean BTC RVol 0.348 (calendar) vs paper 0.634 - discrepancy factor 1.83 suggests paper may use different return frequency, data vintage, or definition (e.g., alternative HAR scaling, or CoinGecko vs Yahoo close differences, or filtering to trading days only vs calendar). We report our computed values transparently; they do not match paper. SD/min/max similarly affected. We provide SE = sd/sqrt(N).
4. Market controls alignment: Kalshi 4pm ET, crypto midnight UTC (7pm ET) same calendar date, minimum 21h gap ensured by lagging signal t-1 before forecasting t+1:t+5. We align VIX/SP500/DXY to 4pm ET close via Yahoo daily bars (their close corresponds to US equity close). Weekends/holidays excluded via common trading index intersection.
5. HAR benchmark M1: RVol = alpha + beta1|r_{t-1}| + beta2 mean|r|^{(5)}_{t-1} + beta3 mean|r|^{(20)}_{t-1} + eps. Without Kalshi signal we cannot estimate M3; M1/M2 coefficients paper reports (Table insample_btc) cannot be replicated because effective N=318 depends on Kalshi availability. We omit those.
6. Inference: Newey-West HAC 5 lags for h=5 overlapping, HC3 for non-overlapping; block bootstrap 2000 resamples block5; Clark-West OOS expanding window 120 initial, MSFE ratio, BH FDR q=0.05 across 60 specs - all require Kalshi signal, thus not rebuilt. Orthogonalization first-stage R2 2.3% (Fed) and 7.5% (CPI) similarly require signal.
7. Out-of-sample: paper reports Noos 144-269 per pair (expanding from 120). Without signal we cannot compute forecasts or CSSED curves. Baseline comparisons vs Fed Funds futures, 10Y Treasury return, Deribit DVOL not fetched (no public free feed for DVOL or futures history in cache).
8. All other claims (t-stats -0.79 composite, 1.24 EMA, BH adj p 0.020/0.042, non-overlap N=64/54, GARCH, logRVol, 21-day, vol-managed 0.348 vs 0.324, options 16% etc) are Kalshi-dependent or horizon-dependent and omitted for same reason; listed in not_rebuilt.
9. Missing/extra: cannot count exact missing because we don't know which of the 1,183 paper days correspond to which of our 1,186; Kalshi missing is complete pre-2025.
